# Oh My Pi RPC 18.12.6 identity

Secret-free identity and per-hop source/tree ledger for `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent` from the qualified `18.8.3` ceiling through official stable `18.12.6`. The npm package inventory records every path and SHA-256 for the ceiling plus all 25 published hops. The hop ledger recomputes complete added, removed, and changed paths and classifies every selected-source change.

The published npm tarball is authoritative because `gitHead` is null. GitHub stable tags in this window match the npm versions one for one. GitHub-only tags `18.0.2`, `18.1.7`, `18.4.7`, and `18.6.2` remain excluded. The deprecated `17.x` segment and the frozen `17.2.9` decoder corpus stay.

The selected tools remain `read`, `grep`, `glob`, `todo`, and `ask`. The 14 selected RPC commands are unchanged. `mr://` is a new read-tier GitLab diff resource inside the existing ambient `read` tool: process principal is ambient `glab`, credentials are `GITLAB_TOKEN`/`GITLAB_ACCESS_TOKEN`/`OAUTH_TOKEN` plus `glab` `config.yml`, network is GitLab egress (host-trust gate constrains env-token forwarding only), and tool-effect is exec of `glab`. `cfg://` still redacts credentials. `ssh` stays exec. Prompt-text `/mcp reauth` is reachable under `--no-extensions` and stays unmapped. `18.12.7` is the synthetic later stable.

No artifact was executed. No provider prompt, login, live catalogue, live session, installation, credential use, or host update occurred.
